normalization.text: Unicode NFKD, lowercase, accent-insensitive, punctuation→space, whitespace collapse.
normalization.matching: Canonical aliases use token/phrase boundary matching; longest aliases are resolved before shorter overlapping aliases.
normalization.grape_masking: Expected grape names/aliases must be masked before review extraction when the benchmark protocol requires varietal masking.

observation_extraction.deduplication: Within one observation, each canonical family/signature/exact/context token is present at most once.

aroma.profile_R: C2-C1 whole-profile R is audit-only in C2-C2. Use stored R_generic per profile for family/signature numerator only.
aroma.tertiary_optional: TERTIARY_OPTIONAL profile markers are eligible only on positive observation and were excluded from static Mp.
anti_double_counting_execution: For every observed exact with a resolved parent also observed, multiply the parent contribution by 0.35 in BOTH numerator and observation denominator.
Generic matched contribution = R_generic * family/signature marker capacity after parent residual.
Exact matched capacities use base 1.50 and are sorted descending; exact numerator = sum e_(j)/sqrt(j).
Observed exact denominator = sum 1.50/sqrt(j) over canonical observed exacts after deduplication.
Exact evidence is not multiplied by R_generic.
aroma.denominator: D_o = D_generic,o + D_exact,o; D_generic uses frozen family/signature base weights and parent residual; D_exact=sum 1.50/sqrt(j).
aroma.numerator: N_op = R_generic,p * matched generic capacity + rank-damped matched exact capacity.

structure.axis_similarity: For observed x and profile [L,U], d=max(L-x,0,x-U); sim=0.82^d.
structure.S: Weighted mean of sim using historical axis_weight×observation_confidence over observed supported axes with q>0; S=0 if none.

catalogue.name: Wood/elevage contradiction
catalogue.aroma_side: Observed exact wood/elevage token among {vanille, toast, cèdre, fumé, café, chocolat} with combined exact evidence >=1.00.
catalogue.structure_or_profile_side: Candidate profile is explicitly wood=0 / no-oak style.
catalogue.mirror_bonus: If profile wood>=1 and observed wood/elevage exact evidence >=1.00, coherence bonus (+0.02*r).
catalogue.guard: Wood evidence is contextual and profile/style-dependent.

catalogue.name: MLF contradiction
catalogue.aroma_side: Observed explicit MLF/lactic markers among {beurre, crème, lactique, yaourt} or frozen MLF token.
catalogue.structure_or_profile_side: Candidate profile is explicitly no-MLF / incompatible vinification context.
catalogue.mirror_bonus: If profile explicitly allows/uses MLF and observation contains MLF evidence, +0.02*r.
catalogue.guard: No penalty for merely not mentioning MLF.

catalogue.name: Ripe-fruit vs fresh/light structural contradiction
catalogue.aroma_side: Ripe set evidence from exact/context markers {confituré/jammy, fruits séchés, raisin sec, figue, fruit cuit} reaches >=1.00.
catalogue.structure_or_profile_side: At least two of: acidité>=4.0, alcool<=2.5, corps<=2.5; reliable-mass condition satisfied.
catalogue.mirror_bonus: If ripe evidence >=1.00 and at least two of acidité<=3.0, alcool>=4.0, corps>=4.0, +0.02*r.
catalogue.guard: Prune, fruits noirs or tropical alone do not count as 'ripe contradiction' markers.

catalogue.name: Fresh/green vs ripe/full structural contradiction
catalogue.aroma_side: Fresh set evidence from exact/context markers {pomme verte, citron, citron vert, pamplemousse, herbacé, feuillu, poivron vert, herbe} reaches >=1.00.
catalogue.structure_or_profile_side: At least two of: acidité<=2.5, alcool>=4.0, corps>=4.0; reliable-mass condition satisfied.
catalogue.mirror_bonus: If fresh evidence >=1.00 and at least two of acidité>=4.0, alcool<=3.0, corps<=3.0, +0.02*r.
catalogue.guard: Menthol/eucalyptus alone do not count as underripe/fresh evidence.

global_activation.aroma_requirement: At least one exact marker with specificity multiplier phi>=0.60 OR two mutually consistent aroma markers whose total weighted evidence >=1.00.
global_activation.structure_requirement: At least two relevant structural axes present and their reliable weight mass / full structural weight >=0.25.
global_activation.absence_rule: Absence of an expected aroma never activates a contradiction.
global_activation.text_rule: A single text-derived structural axis can never activate C.

coherence.general_formula: C_p = clamp(sum_j c_j * r_j, -0.08, +0.04), where c_j is -0.04 for contradiction rules and +0.02 for coherence rules; r_j in [0,1] is joint signal reliability.
explicit_non_rules: Floral/red-fruit plus high tannin/body is NOT a contradiction (avoids invalidating Nebbiolo-like legitimate styles).
High tannin with delicate aromas is NOT a generic contradiction.
Any one-axis mismatch is NOT a coherence contradiction.
Missing fruit/aroma markers are NOT contradictions.
A rule may not name a grape variety.

runtime_flags.C2-C1_negative_no_oak: DORMANT — no explicit no-oak profile flag exists in C2-02.
runtime_flags.C2-C1_positive_wood: ACTIVE — every profile has one source-backed wood level field; exact wood evidence is profile/style contextualized.
runtime_flags.C2-C2_negative_no_MLF: DORMANT — absence of explicit MLF is not treated as explicit no-MLF.
runtime_flags.C2-C3_ripe_vs_fresh_light: ACTIVE subject to frozen evidence/reliability conditions.
runtime_flags.C2-C4_fresh_green_vs_ripe_full: ACTIVE subject to frozen evidence/reliability conditions.

integrated.profile_aggregation: MAX across native regional/style profiles of the same grape, unchanged from S3.
integrated.tie_break: Higher integrated score, then higher effective structure, then stable alphabetical grape key.

scoring_order: 1. Extract/mask observation according to dataset protocol.
3. Compute A_p for each of 203 profiles.
4. Compute S_eff,p from supported structural axes and profile intervals.
5. Evaluate only the closed coherence catalogue and compute C_p.
7. Aggregate profiles to grape by MAX; rank with frozen tie-break.
8. Emit integrated/aroma-only/structure-only ranks plus coherence diagnostics.
